update_tags.set_html:
<script>
(function () {
  if (window.__ldvBlockTime) return;
  window.__ldvBlockTime = true;
  var NAMES = {"ldvc": "hero", "ldv-form-section": "form_a", "ldvq": "quiz", "ldvq-top": "hero", "ldvq-card": "quiz", "ldv-form-2-section": "form_b", ".vb-f3a#ldv-form": "form_a", "ldv-form": "form_a", ".ldv2-native": "form_a"};
  var IDS = ["ldv-ai-hero", "ldv-your-crash", "ldv-crash-scenarios", "ldv-case-examples", "ldv-truck-cases", "ldv-evidence", "ldv-mid-review", "ldv-public-library", "ldv-injuries", "ldv-early-offer", "ldv-case-value", "ldv-case-process", "ldv-why-landver", "ldv-reviews", "ldv-faq", "ldv-final-review", "ldv-footer", "ldvc", "ldv-form-section", "ldv-insurers", "ldv-how", "ldv-fee", "ldv-team", "ldv-situations", "ldv-attorney", "ldvq", "ldv-final", "ldvq-top", "ldvq-card", "ldv-why", "ldv-form-2-section", ".vb-f3a#ldv-form", ".ldv2-native"];
  var PREFIX = "ldv-";
  var STEPS = [[10, 'stay_10s'], [30, 'engaged_30s'], [90, 'engaged_90s']];
  var TICK = 500, IDLE = 10000, FLUSH = 30000;
  var acc = {}, total = 0, current = 'header', lastTick = Date.now(), lastActive = Date.now(), lastFlush = Date.now();
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  function nameOf(id) { return NAMES[id] || id.replace(new RegExp('^' + PREFIX), '').replace(/-/g, '_'); }
  function find(id) { return /^[.#\[]/.test(id) ? document.querySelector(id) : document.getElementById(id); }
  function currentBlock() {
    var mid = window.innerHeight / 2, name = 'header', best = -1e9;
    for (var i = 0; i < IDS.length; i++) {
      var el = find(IDS[i]);
      if (!el) continue;
      var top = el.getBoundingClientRect().top;
      if (top <= mid && top > best) { best = top; name = nameOf(IDS[i]); }
    }
    return name;
  }
  function flush(final) {
    for (var k in acc) {
      var s = final ? Math.round(acc[k]) : Math.floor(acc[k]);
      if (s >= 1) { window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'block_time', block_name: k, block_seconds: s }); acc[k] -= s; }
    }
    lastFlush = Date.now();
  }
  function active() { lastActive = Date.now(); }
  ['scroll', 'mousemove', 'keydown', 'touchstart', 'click', 'wheel'].forEach(function (e) { window.addEventListener(e, active, { passive: true }); });
  setInterval(function () {
    var now = Date.now(), dt = now - lastTick;
    lastTick = now;
    var block = currentBlock();
    if (document.visibilityState === 'visible' && now - lastActive <= IDLE && dt < 5000) {
      acc[block] = (acc[block] || 0) + dt / 1000;
      total += dt / 1000;
      while (STEPS.length && total >= STEPS[0][0]) { window.dataLayer.push({ event: STEPS[0][1] }); STEPS.shift(); }
    }
    if (block !== current) { flush(false); current = block; }
    else if (now - lastFlush >= FLUSH) { flush(false); }
  }, TICK);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') flush(true); });
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', function () { flush(true); });
})();
</script>
